text:
```yaml
name: Portability Validation

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *' # Runs daily at 2:00 AM UTC
  workflow_dispatch: # Allows manual triggering
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - qumun/**
      - main.go
      - Makefile

jobs:
  portability:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        kernel-version: ['6.12.2', '6.13', '6.14', '6.15', '6.16', '6.17']
      fail-fast: false

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v2
      with:
        go-version: '1.17'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: make install-deps

    - name: Build Gthulhu
      run: make build-kernel VERSION=${{ matrix.kernel-version }}

    - name: Run tests
      run: make test-kernel VERSION=${{ matrix.kernel-version }}
```
